match: pgkv=Err\('SETRANGE past the end of the string needs zero-byte padding
why: SETRANGE past the end of a string pads with zero bytes in Redis; pgkv values are text and cannot hold them, so it is an error

match: pgkv=Err\('(GETRANGE|SETRANGE) range splits a multi-byte UTF-8 character
why: a byte range that cuts a multi-byte character in half returns raw bytes in Redis; pgkv values are text, so it is an error

match: oracle=Err\('increment or decrement would overflow'\) pgkv=Err\('value is not an integer or out of range'\)
why: INCRBYFLOAT is long double arithmetic in Redis and exact decimal arithmetic in pgkv: 9223372036854775807 + 0.1 stays an integer in Redis and is 9223372036854775807.1 in pgkv
